method: Unchanged official provider RGE ALTI elevation responses for an independently chosen regular 2m local grid, before model authoring. No clipping, smoothing, flattening or fitting to geometry. Provider rounds values to 0.01m.
limitations: Effective source resolution and surveyed accuracy are not specified by the API. Building/bridge areas may be interpolated in the terrain product.
Hydrographic surface levels are source-epoch values, not bathymetry, live water levels or engineering clearance.
Baseline Terrarium values contain large building/site returns and are preserved for comparison; independent official terrain is used for the site review.
